authority_ref: Dealix #1317 and Autonomous Company Machine V2
purpose: Measure internal workload economics and time-to-evidence without promoting activity to commercial value.
hard_rules: time_to_evidence requires a source-linked output evidence ref and an in-window timestamp
cost is attributable only when provider/model/token counts are present
payment proof is not inferred from an invoice, proposal, recommendation, or successful workload
customer value and revenue remain UNKNOWN_NOT_EVIDENCE_BACKED
synthetic evidence must remain labeled and cannot become customer proof
no new truth store, dashboard, scheduler, or agent fleet

aggregation.sorting: stable lexicographic by workload_id then run_id
aggregation.generated_at: metadata only and excluded from semantic equality
